name: pagerduty
description: Read PagerDuty incidents, services, and on-call schedules using the user's own API key. Load to see open incidents and who is on call.

content.inline:
## PagerDuty
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.pagerduty.com` with `secretHeaders: {"Authorization": "s/PAGERDUTY_TOKEN"}` (an API key: Integrations -> API Access Keys). The stored value is the complete `Token token=<key>` header. Always send `Accept: application/vnd.pagerduty+json;version=2`. Only the secret reference goes in the request; never the key.

Common calls:
- Sanity check: `GET /abilities`
- Open incidents: `GET /incidents?statuses[]=triggered&statuses[]=acknowledged&sort_by=created_at:desc`
- One incident: `GET /incidents/{id}`
- Services: `GET /services?limit=100`
- Who is on call: `GET /oncalls?earliest=true` (scope with `schedule_ids[]=`)

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{error: {code, message, errors}}`. 401 = bad key.
- Array filters repeat the key with `[]`, e.g. `statuses[]=triggered&statuses[]=acknowledged`.
- Reads work with any valid key; writing an incident is a `PUT` (no `http/put` op yet), so do acknowledge/resolve in the PagerDuty UI for now.
